title: The Story of Austin: Downtown History Walking Tour
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Recommended for ages 13+ due to content.
policies: Places to sit at each stop are not provided.
You may use the restroom at Halcyon Coffee. Let them know you're with the walking tour.
Let Halcyon Coffee know you're there for the tour and receive 10% off your drink order.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: From cowboys to condominiums, take a walk through the story of Austin, beginning and ending in what was once a roaring red light district turned warehouse district in Austin’s earlier years. Along the way, we'll explore the rich history of Austin and discover how it became the vibrant and dynamic city it is today, with emphasis on the eccentric and heroic Austinites who shaped Austin's story. This tour is not suggested for children under 13. Large Group? Visit our website. This is an outdoor tour that stays outside.
